The plan
Step
1
Arrival and check-in
Sign in at the dropzone and bring your photo ID.
Step
2
Safety briefing and gear fitting
Meet your instructor for the safety briefing and harness fitting.
Step
3
Boarding and the climb
Board the aircraft and climb to jump altitude.
Step
4
Exit and freefall
Exit with your instructor for freefall over the Gulf of Thailand.
Step
5
Canopy flight and landing
Fly under the parachute with your instructor and land back at the dropzone.
At the dropzone: 3h
Exit altitude: 13,000 ft
60 seconds of freefall
The details
Everything that comes with this experience, and what to plan for yourself.
Highlights
•
Exit at 13,000 ft with the Gulf of Thailand on the horizon
•
Around sixty seconds of freefall, then five to seven minutes under canopy along the coast
•
No experience needed: your USPA-certified instructor flies the jump
•
Same aircraft, altitude and instructors in every package

Sea View Tandem Skydive - Pattaya
•
A tandem skydiving experience over Pattaya with ocean views. Guests receive a safety briefing, fly to jump altitude, complete the tandem jump with a certified instructor, and choose from ECO, Deluxe, or VIP package options depending on the media coverage they want.
Where you jump
•
Pattaya Sea View, Pattaya, Thailand
•
95 M.4, Chakphong, Klaeng District, Rayong 21190, Thailand
Operated by
•
Dropzone Thailand
Good to know
Where does the activity take place?
The tandem skydive is listed for Pattaya, Thailand.
Which package should I choose?
Choose ECO for the standard jump, Deluxe if you want handy cam video, and VIP if you want full media coverage.
Is Bangkok pickup available?
Yes. Bangkok pickup is available as a fixed-price add-on.
